title: Generics

outcomes.can: Identify the runtime values returned by a generic function and explain a type-only projection.
Keep the first value even when falsey

Keep both sides of a pair

intro: A generic type parameter connects types across positions. In choose<T>(value: T): T the caller supplies one type and receives that same type back. The type parameter is erased when JavaScript runs. Pick<Task, "id"> keeps named fields, Omit<Task, "id"> removes them, and Partial<…> makes the remaining fields optional in the type.

steps.title: Trace the example
steps.text: The same function handles a number and a string. Inference picks a type from the arguments at each call. A broad return type such as unknown loses the connection. Utility types describe compile-time shapes. Creating a projection at runtime still requires code that selects its actual fields.

questions.prompt: Does Pick automatically remove properties from a JavaScript object?

choices.text: Yes. It deletes all unselected keys.
